question:
Solve the following system of linear equations using matrix method: [5 marks]
$2x - 3y + 5z = 11$
$3x + 2y - 4z = -5$
$x + y - 2z = -3$
solutionSteps: Let $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & -3 & 5 \\ 3 & 2 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \end{pmatrix}, X = \begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{pmatrix}, B = \begin{pmatrix} 11 \\ -5 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix}$.

case_study: Three schools A, B and C decided to award their selected students for three values of Honesty (x), Punctuality (y) and Obedience (z). School A decided to award ₹11,000 for the three values to 2, 3 and 4 students respectively. School B decided to award ₹10,700 to 3, 2 and 1 students respectively. School C decided to award ₹9,100 to 1, 3 and 2 students respectively. [4 marks]

parts.i: Represent the above information in terms of a matrix equation $AX=B$.
parts.iii: Find the award money for each value (x, y, z).

solutionSteps: i) Matrix equation: $\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 & 2 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 11000 \\ 10700 \\ 9100 \end{pmatrix}$.
iii) Solving $X = A^{-1}B$ gives $x = 2100, y = 1000, z = 1200$.

question: For what value of $k$, the system of equations $x + 2y = 3$ and $5x + ky = 7$ has a unique solution? [1 mark]

case_study: A farmer produces three types of crops X, Y and Z. The selling price per unit is ₹2.50, ₹1.50 and ₹1.00 respectively. The cost price per unit is ₹2.00, ₹1.00 and ₹0.50 respectively. The annual sale (in units) is given by the matrix $P = \begin{pmatrix} 10000 & 2000 & 18000 \\ 6000 & 20000 & 8000 \end{pmatrix}$. [4 marks]

parts.i: Find the total revenue from each market using matrix algebra.
parts.ii: Find the total profit from each market using matrix algebra.

solutionSteps: i) Revenue matrix $= P \times S$, where $S = \begin{pmatrix} 2.50 \\ 1.50 \\ 1.00 \end{pmatrix}$.
ii) Profit matrix $= P \times (S - C)$, where $S-C = \begin{pmatrix} 0.50 \\ 0.50 \\ 0.50 \end{pmatrix}$.
finalAnswer: Market I Profit: ₹15000, Market II Profit: ₹17000
